problems.title: Inconsistent manufactured solutions in core validation
problems.claim: Eq25,49,55 are exact solutions of the stated PDEs/forcings and substantiate accurate convergent data-free solving.
problems.location: PDF p13 Eq23-25/mainFig2/Fig10; pp20-22 Eq46,48-49/Fig15; p23 Eq53-55/Fig16
assumptions: Poisson domain [0,100]^2 and boundary exact u25
Spacetime k=1, t=log(2)/15, x=100t+5,y=z=0 within stated domain
Elasticity n1=n2=n3=1, constant Lame parameters, homogeneous boundary, x=y=1/4,z=1
problems.check: Independent symbolic derivatives, exact-point residuals, subharmonic unit-disk error bound and isotropic exchange symmetry.
problems.result: Poisson Lap=-1.6+260.8exp(-164) versus f=0.000914259157897527; actual printed-PDE error sup>=1/8. Spacetime11/2 vs1589exp(-100)/2. Elasticity b1-b2=-132176378437499sqrt(2)/1e6 despite zero operator difference.
problems.counterevidence: Publication/transcription errors with correctly implemented experiments remain plausible. Available scripts solve different problems; actual generating solver absent. Other sine benchmarks consistent.
problems.impact: Core accuracy/interpretability/convergence evidence is invalid as specified; no assertion that hidden historical run used printed forcing.

correction.statement: Poisson and spacetime corrected sources obtained by differentiation; elasticity requires b=-mu Delta u-(mu+lambda)grad div u with specified constants.
correction.limits: No corrected experimental figures or performance rerun.

focused_acceptance.source_location: PDF p13 Eq23-25/mainFig2/Fig10; pp20-22 Eq46,48-49/Fig15; p23 Eq53-55/Fig16
focused_acceptance.assumptions_and_decisive_evidence: The printed Poisson, moving-source, and elasticity examples were compared with the stated operators and domains. At (60,75), the Poisson Laplacian is -1.6+260.8 exp(-164), incompatible with the displayed forcing; the unit-disk argument gives sup error at least 1/8. The admissible moving-source point gives 11/2 versus (1589/2) exp(-100). With n1=n2=n3=1 and x=y, elasticity symmetry requires equal first two forcing components, contrary to the printed coefficients.
focused_acceptance.counterevidence_and_limits: These could be manuscript transcription errors while the historical solvers used consistent equations. The checks do not reconstruct historical fields, boundary data, or experimental execution.
focused_acceptance.core_dependency_and_severity: The examples substantiate the core accuracy, local-interpretability, and convergence validation. Their demonstrated incompatibility with the claimed exact references supports Major even without rerunning the solver.
focused_acceptance.correction_scope: The two displayed corrected forcing expressions follow by differentiation; they are analytic corrections, not verified reruns or replacement historical results.

problems.title: Held-out target extrema enter released preprocessing
problems.claim: Held-out evaluation with separate train/validation/test files in paper-linked configuration.
problems.check: Track concatenated targets into training scaling; fixed training[0,1] with heldout2 vs100.
problems.result: Training normalized maximum changes1/2 to1/100 with heldout labels.
problems.counterevidence: Predeclared physical bounds could be valid but are not this code; test updates not retained; original CSV and run settings unavailable.
problems.impact: Release-protocol dependence established; magnitude and historical score effect Needs Evidence.

correction.statement: Fit scaling on training set or independent predeclared bounds and freeze before evaluation.

focused_acceptance.assumptions_and_decisive_evidence: The released three-file branch concatenates training and held-out data before taking target minima/maxima, and STP_icml.yaml enables normalization. With fixed training labels {0,1}, changing the held-out maximum from 2 to 100 changes the normalized training maximum from 1/2 to 1/100.
focused_acceptance.counterevidence_and_limits: The check establishes dependence of training preprocessing on held-out target extrema. It does not establish which release or normalization path generated the historical table or quantify a resulting score change.
focused_acceptance.core_dependency_and_severity: Minor is retained for this bounded release preprocessing defect; the historical core-result dependency remains unbound.
focused_acceptance.correction_scope: Training-only fit of normalization parameters is the appropriate protocol correction. No corrected experimental score is asserted.
